_comment: [CHANGE: claude-code | 2026-07-25] The hooks that used to live here have MOVED to user scope (~/.claude/settings.json). Do not put them back. Reason: Cowork / Claude Desktop launches Claude Code with `--setting-sources=user`, so this file is never read there and the hooks were silently dead in every Cowork session -- confirmed by graph.db going untouched across a full editing session while the same hooks worked from a terminal. User scope is the only location loaded by BOTH the CLI and Cowork. The user-scope hooks call self-gating wrappers (scripts/luminos-hook-*) so they stay silent in unrelated projects. Keeping a second copy here would double-fire the graph update in the CLI, where both scopes load.
